question: Change the phone number or email on my profile
variants: I want to change the phone number linked to my profile
how do I update my email address
change contact details on my account
steps: Open the app and go to Profile, then Contact info.
Tap Edit next to the number or email. We'll text a one-time code to your current number, so enter that when it arrives.
Type the new number or email and tap Save. You'll get a confirmation on the new one within a minute.
if_not_resolved: If the code isn't reaching you because you no longer have that number, I can verify you with your account PIN and ID and make the change from here.

question: Reset my password or account PIN
variants: I can't log in even after resetting my password
steps: On the login screen, tap Forgot password and enter the email or number on the account.
Open the reset link we send. It's valid for 30 minutes, so if it's older than that, request a new one.
Choose a new password with at least 8 characters, then log in with it in the app, not with a saved password in your browser.
if_not_resolved: If you still can't get in, I'll verify you here and reset it for you directly.

question: Account locked after failed logins
variants: it says my account is temporarily blocked
steps: After five failed attempts the account locks for 30 minutes. Has it been longer than 30 minutes since the last attempt?
Close the app fully, reopen it and log in once, carefully. If you're not sure of the password, use Forgot password instead of guessing again.
if_not_resolved: I'll verify your identity and unlock it right now.

question: Two-factor authentication
variants: do you support two-factor authentication with a hardware key
add extra security to my login
steps: We support two-factor authentication with SMS codes or an authenticator app, and you turn it on in the app under Security. Hardware security keys aren't supported yet.

question: Account or line opened with my details
variants: my teenage son signed up with my details, how do I delete his profile
someone opened an account in my name
somebody used my details to open a line
steps: I'm going to flag this to our fraud team and put a block on any new lines in your name while they look into it.
They'll need to confirm which lines you didn't set up. Can you tell me the last four digits of any number you don't recognise?
Thanks. The case is open, and the fraud team will contact you within 24 hours. You'll get the case number by SMS now.
if_not_resolved: I'll mark the case as urgent so a supervisor picks it up today.

question: Add an authorised user
variants: can my wife call about my account
add someone who can manage my plan
steps: The account holder can add an authorised user in the app under Profile, then Authorised users. That person passes a short verification the first time they contact us.

question: Charged twice or an unexpected charge
variants: My card was charged twice for the same order
there is a charge I don't recognise on my bill
steps: Open the app and go to Billing, then Payments, and check whether each charge says Pending or Completed.

If either one says Pending, that's a temporary hold that drops off by itself in 3 to 5 working days. If both say Completed, I'll raise a refund for the duplicate now, and it reaches your card in 5 to 7 working days.
if_not_resolved: I'll pass it to our billing team to investigate, and they'll get back to you within 2 working days.

question: Understand a bill or when it is due
variants: when is my next billing date
explain the charges on my bill
why is my bill higher this month
steps: Your bill date and every line item are in the app under Billing, then Latest bill.
If the amount changed, the usual reason is a plan change mid-month, which shows up as a one-off pro-rated charge, or a roaming or add-on charge listed separately.

question: Payment failed or late payment
variants: will I be disconnected for paying late
steps: First, check that the card saved under Billing, then Payment method hasn't expired.
If the card is fine, tap Pay now on the latest bill to retry. Service is only restricted after 14 days overdue, so you're not at risk today.
If it goes through, service stays as it is, and if it had been restricted it comes back within an hour.
if_not_resolved: If it still won't go through, I can set up a 14-day payment extension for you right now.

question: Switch plan or add a data pack
steps: In the app, go to Plans to see the plans available on your number.
For extra data this month, choose Add-ons and pick a pack. It starts working straight away and is charged on your next bill.
To change your plan instead, choose Change plan. An upgrade starts today, and a downgrade starts from your next bill date.
if_not_resolved: I can look at your usage over the last three months and suggest the plan that fits best.

question: Roaming charges and travel packs
steps: Roaming is off by default. You can turn it on in the app under Roaming, and a travel pack bought before you go works out much cheaper than pay-as-you-go.
If you've been charged for roaming you didn't expect, I can review that usage and may be able to adjust it.

question: Cancel service or end contract
variants: I want to cancel my contract
steps: I can start that for you. First I'll check your contract end date and any early-termination fee, so you know the exact figure before deciding.
Before I go ahead, would a cheaper plan or a pause on the line suit you better? If not, I'll carry on with the cancellation.
Okay, I've submitted the cancellation. You'll get written confirmation and your final bill date by email within the hour.
if_not_resolved: I'll connect you to our retentions team, who can confirm the final details with you.

question: Track a SIM or device order
steps: Open the app and go to Orders, then tap Track on your order for the live courier link.
Standard delivery is 2 to 3 working days from dispatch. If it's been longer than that, tell me your order number and I'll check with the courier.
if_not_resolved: I'll open a trace with the courier, and if it isn't found within 48 hours we'll send a replacement free.

question: Delivery delayed or marked delivered but missing
variants: order says delivered but I don't have it
steps: I'm sorry about this. Could you check with neighbours, and in any safe place the courier might have used?
Thanks for checking. I'm opening a trace with the courier now, and they'll report back within 48 hours.
If it isn't found, we'll send a replacement at no cost and email you the new tracking link.
if_not_resolved: I'll escalate it so a replacement goes out today instead of waiting on the trace.

question: Faulty or wrong device received
steps: I'm sorry about that. You have 14 days to return it, and for a damaged or wrong item the return is free.
Could you send a photo of the item through the app under Orders, then Report a problem?
Thanks. I've booked a free courier pick-up, and the replacement ships as soon as the courier collects the item.
if_not_resolved: I'll ask a supervisor to approve sending the replacement before we receive the return.

question: Activate a new SIM or eSIM
variants: how do I activate my SIM
steps: Put the SIM in and restart the phone. For an eSIM, go to Settings, then Mobile data, then Add eSIM.
Open our app, tap Activate SIM, and scan the code on the SIM card or the QR code from your email.
Activation takes about 15 minutes. After that, restart the phone once more and you should see our network name at the top.
if_not_resolved: Let me run a check on the SIM from here. If it's faulty, I'll send a replacement today.

question: Transfer my number from another provider
variants: switch to you from another network
can I keep my number if I switch
steps: Don't cancel your old plan yet, because cancelling releases the number. First, text PORT to your current provider to get a transfer code.
When the code arrives, enter it in our app under Number transfer, or read it out to me.
The switch completes within one working day. You'll lose signal for a few minutes while it happens, then your number works on our network.
if_not_resolved: I'll contact the other provider directly to push the transfer through.

question: No signal or slow data
steps: Let's start simple: turn on airplane mode for 10 seconds, then turn it off.
If that didn't help, restart the phone, and check that Mobile data and Roaming are set correctly under Settings.
Now I'll check for an outage near you. What's your postcode?
if_not_resolved: There's no outage reported there, so I'll run a line test and book an engineer visit if it finds a fault.
